title: Project Overview
summary: A research codebase for the LIMI fairness/discrimination testing method, which searches for individual-fairness violations and evaluates candidate models against baselines. It vendors a renamed copy of the CTGAN library (limictgan, including its TVAE synthesizer and rdt-based data transformer) as one baseline generator and separately imports sdmetrics' QualityReport for evaluation, so SDV-family code is both vendored and run.
